verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AI building blocks rather than a turnkey in-product insights feature. Elasticsearch embeds data automatically via semantic_text, can pass requests to OpenAI chat completions through its inference integration, and positions itself for RAG and question-answering apps. Users would still have to assemble these pieces into their own insight-generation flow. Missing for 10: a documented in-product AI assistant or feature that surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data, any description of the suggestion or insight UX, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
